summary.text: Tom McInnis is a Republican state senator from North Carolina who represents District 21, covering Cumberland and Moore counties, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Paul Taylor.
He has served in the Senate since 2015 and chairs the Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: McInnis lists Indiana University-Bloomington in his education and a profession of chief operations officer, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists his Senate tenure as beginning in 2015.

The General Assembly's website shows McInnis chairing the Finance Committee, the Regulatory Reform Committee and the Select Committee on Property Tax Reform, and serving as co-chair of the Revenue Laws Study Committee.
He also serves on the Agriculture, Energy, and Environment; Commerce and Insurance; Education/Higher Education; Rules and Operations of the Senate; and Transportation committees.
McInnis advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.
